prompts.isolamento: Use case: stylized-concept. Create production source modular environment sprite sheet for Ashen Veil, gothic dark fantasy 2D SIDE SCROLLER. Detailed painterly game textures, NOT coarse pixel art, dark charcoal violet-gray dressed stone, rusty iron, restrained amber edge highlights. Orthographic FRONT/SIDE elevation, no isometric perspective, no scene or characters. True transparent background including openings. Exactly 16 isolated architectural modules in evenly spaced 4 columns x 4 rows on square 1024x1024 canvas; each tile wholly inside its 256x256 cell with 12px transparent gutter. No labels, no grid lines, no baked halo, no cast shadow outside sprite. Matching stone block scale and same flat walkable top thickness across kits. These are modular construction pieces, not miniature scenes. Read order left-right top-bottom: ISOLATION WING: 1 intact violet stone floor slab, 2 cracked same floor slab, 3 iron-reinforced same floor slab, 4 broken floor end; 5 ash-gray plaster over dark stone wall, 6 peeling plaster wall exposing bricks, 7 wall with small barred observation slit, 8 wall with scratches/tally incisions no text; 9 rectangular heavy iron door CLOSED in stone frame, 10 matching door OPEN with transparent opening, 11 narrow square stone pillar, 12 broken same pillar; 13 stone arch left shoulder, 14 matching arch right shoulder, 15 stone lintel center, 16 transition wall half plaster half exposed prison masonry. Ominous abandoned solitary confinement, dry dusty surfaces, subdued cold purple, strong readable silhouettes.

prompts.props_servico: Use case: stylized-concept. Ashen Veil modular prison props sprite sheet. Exactly FOUR isolated full objects in 2x2 grid, square canvas, real transparent background. Detailed dark gothic painterly 2D side-scroller art, charcoal violet shadows, muted rusty amber highlights, weathered believable medieval prison objects, not pixel art, not isometric. Orthographic side/front elevation with minimal visible top, flat ground contact baseline in each cell, generous empty gutters, no cropped parts, no labels or backdrop, no glow or ground shadows. Top left: abandoned prison infirmary wheeled stretcher, stained faded gray-purple cloth and iron frame, four grounded wheels. Top right: guards' key cabinet on short feet, dark wood with tiny hanging keys, lower locked drawers. Bottom left: prison workshop low workbench, vice fixed to side, neatly hanging chain links and battered tongs, grounded sturdy legs. Bottom right: communal prison kitchen soot black cast iron cooking cauldron supported on low stone hearth, unlit, lid resting to side as part of same sprite. Distinct readable silhouettes, consistent material palette, objects suitable for placing in interconnected prison service rooms. No characters, no gore.
